transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ChatGPT. What brings you in today?
I'm here because I've been having a really hard time staying focused. I get distracted so easily by every little thing around me, and I wanted to get some help with it.
Do you also find yourself feeling very restless, fidgety, or interrupting others, or is the main problem just inattention and distractibility?

No, I don't really experience restlessness or fidgeting, and I don't have trouble with interrupting others. My main struggle is definitely just the inattention and getting easily distracted by my surroundings or my own thoughts.
Over the past few weeks, have you also been feeling down, losing interest or pleasure in things, or having excessive worry that's hard to control?

No, I haven't really felt down or excessively worried lately. My mood is generally fine, but I'm just constantly struggling with being easily distracted and forgetting to do basic daily things like chores or paying my bills.
Have these attention and forgetfulness problems been present since childhood or the teen years, and do they happen in more than one setting like home, work, or school?

Yes, I've actually had these issues since I was a kid, definitely starting before I turned 12. It affects me in pretty much every part of my life, from struggling with chores and bills at home to constantly forgetting errands and appointments.
